items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson was a full participant in practice Wednesday for the first time since his ankle injury. Rapoport and Schefter confirm the upgrade; he is expected to play Sunday vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since injury; Rapoport expected him to play based on sources.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; major upgrade for pass-catchers and Henry.
items.opportunity: Higher volume and efficiency for Flowers/Andrews/Henry with Jackson under center.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) were non-participants at Wednesday's practice. Gibbs' shoulder is a new designation after prior ankle scare cleared.
items.why: New shoulder for Gibbs; St. Brown ankle from prior. Multiple Lions rested but these injury-listed.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday; low concern yet but key RB1/WR4 statuses.
items.opportunity: If OUT, handcuff/backup snaps for Vaki/Saylors; Williams upside.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a non-participant in Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury and rest.
items.implication: Likely precautionary but monitor; Tee Higgins/others could see more if limited.
items.opportunity: Potential route/target bump for Higgins if Chase limited.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle aggravated chest injury Sunday; status for Week 8 vs KC TBD. Did not practice Wednesday.
From NFL roundup context and prior: Breece Hall (quad) limited in practice; Allen also limited ankle. Monitor Jets backfield.
items.opportunity: If full, reclaim lead; else Allen continues.

items.text: Matthew Berry repeatedly pushes Jonah Coleman as must-add waiver: keep saying until 100% rostered. Highlights as top RB target; ETR notes time to move forward with Coleman in DEN backfield.
items.why: Led snaps/carries in return from IR; Payton wants more touches; outproduced Dobbins/Harvey.
items.implication: Priority add; potential lead back or committee winner.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Declan Doyle cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite efficiency even with backup QB; Lamar return multiplies.
items.implication: Flowers WR1 upside unlocked; buy if available.
items.opportunity: Higher target quality and volume with Jackson.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitomizes high-value-touch thesis at RB: arguably worst runner in NFL (53rd EPA/play, last in YPC 3.1) yet fantasy RB13 full-PPR PPG via 9 carries inside-5 and NFL-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume in red zone and targets overcome poor efficiency metrics.
items.implication: Sustainable floor despite bad runner grades; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and receiving work keep him viable even in bad scheme.
items.conflict: Worst runner metrics vs fantasy production.

items.text: Berry keeping it open on Sam LaPorta: could be in for big day vs Vikings D that pressures Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure defense favors TE checkdowns.

items.text: Texans placed WR Jaylin Noel on IR (toe); claimed Emari Demercado. Noel left early prior game.
Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup? Berry discusses on Pregame.
items.why: Return from injury; evaluate immediate startability.
items.implication: Potential SEA RB role; monitor snaps.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba special: lost OC Klint Kubiak, few other threats, DCs shading, stadium knows ball going to him—yet still +9 actual fantasy points over opportunity implied.
items.implication: Elite WR1 ROS despite offensive changes.
items.opportunity: Continues high target share and efficiency.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind Allen), Gibbs RB1 (+3.9 Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given talent/schedule.
items.why: Concentrated production and defensive woes drive numbers.
items.implication: Start all Lions skill confidently; Gibbs clear RB1.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Noel 15 (left early turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, MHJ 8, Tank Dell 6 (first since 2024).
items.why: Clear route lead even with Dell return.
items.implication: Nico alpha WR; Dell limited role.
